question: Should `plugins/memos-cloud` remain a supported Crabpot fixture, with declared seam metadata and expectations, or should this repository stop advancing the unconfigured submodule?
rationale: The repository policy requires fixture ownership in configuration, but choosing whether to retain this external plugin as a fixture is a product and test-corpus decision rather than a safe mechanical correction.

options.title: Register the fixture
options.body: Add a `memos-cloud` fixture entry with its unique seam, `why`, and matching generated report or test expectations before updating the gitlink.

options.title: Defer the source update
options.body: Keep the current revision until a maintainer sponsors the fixture and its inspection contract.

recommendation.title: Register the fixture
recommendation.body: Add a `memos-cloud` fixture entry with its unique seam, `why`, and matching generated report or test expectations before updating the gitlink.
